answer: Registration locks a 500 POA bond. A replayed submission, meaning a near-duplicate above 0.8 similarity against an earlier answer, claws that bond back and hands it to the panel that caught it. The cheapest attack reuses one text 50 times, costing 25,000 POA plus the locked score. A new velvet label does not help, because the match runs on the text and its pigment, and the ivory-pale fifth copy is caught like the first.
